achievements.name: Portal Device
achievements.detail: Pick up the portal device and open a portal on a white surface in a test chamber.

achievements.name: Two Colors
achievements.detail: Receive the upgrade that fires both colors and link an orange portal to a blue one.

achievements.name: Chamber Clear
achievements.detail: Finish a numbered test chamber and ride the elevator to the next one.

achievements.name: Pellet Catch
achievements.detail: Steer a high-energy pellet into its catcher by moving a portal into the pellet's path.

achievements.name: Companion Cube
achievements.detail: Carry the Weighted Companion Cube through Test Chamber 17 and finish that chamber.

achievements.name: Camera Off
achievements.detail: Place a portal so a security camera is pulled off its wall mount.

achievements.name: Turret Tip
achievements.detail: Knock a turret over by dropping a second turret onto it.

achievements.name: Long Fling
achievements.detail: Fall into a portal and come out fast enough to cross a gap you could not jump.

achievements.name: Long Drop
achievements.detail: Keep falling through linked portals for a huge drop and still walk out of the exit.

achievements.name: Advanced Map
achievements.detail: Clear one of the six chambers on the advanced course.

achievements.name: All Advanced
achievements.detail: Clear all six chambers on the advanced course.

achievements.name: Gold Medals
achievements.detail: Earn a gold medal for time, portals, and steps on every challenge chamber.

achievements.name: Course Done
achievements.detail: Finish the final chamber and leave the test course.
